prompt: The reference image shows the game's art: chunky wooden raised garden beds with crops, in cel-shaded toon 3D with dark-brown ink outlines, strict isometric view. Use exactly these beds, drawn the same way, inside the app UI. A polished mobile app screen mockup, portrait phone screen filling the whole image edge to edge, Android status bar at the top, crisp readable UI text in a friendly rounded sans-serif font, no device frame, no hands. The screen is the pause that appears over a social video feed: behind, a blurred and dimmed vertical video feed; in front, a large bottom sheet. On the sheet: a small pill "Feed paused", a small line "Before the next video", a big card with the isometric bed of nine radishes, the task title "Call mom" in large bold text with "For today" under it, then three stacked full-width buttons: "Do it now" (the main one), "Pick a time", and "Snooze 5 min · once", and a small hint "Pick one to get back to the feed." Visual style: a cozy farming game. Warm cream parchment background with a faint paper grain, a carved wooden plank sign holding the title, cards framed in rounded light wood like the beds, chunky rounded buttons in leaf green with a darker bottom edge like toy blocks, warm brown text.
